CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Use My Purpose to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of My Purpose with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.
   D. Say My Purpose has no place in daily life.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Inspired Word of God? (1 mark)
   A. Use Inspired Word of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Inspired Word of God has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Inspired Word of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Inspired Word of God.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Miracle of Healing? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Miracle of Healing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Miracle of Healing has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Miracle of Healing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracle of Healing.

6. Which response best shows understanding of The Temptations of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Temptations of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say The Temptations of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Temptations of Jesus Christ.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Temptations of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Call of Disciples? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Call of Disciples to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of The Call of Disciples with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Call of Disciples.
   D. Say The Call of Disciples has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Faith in God Elisha? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith in God Elisha.
   B. Apply the teaching of Faith in God Elisha with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Faith in God Elisha has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Faith in God Elisha to insult classmates of other faiths.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Marriage and Family? (1 mark)
   A. Say Marriage and Family has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Marriage and Family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Marriage and Family.
   D. Use Marriage and Family to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

11. Which response best shows understanding of Leisure? (1 mark)
   A. Say Leisure has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Leisure with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Leisure to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Leisure.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Jacob Wrestles an Angel? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jacob Wrestles an Angel with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Jacob Wrestles an Angel has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jacob Wrestles an Angel.
   D. Use Jacob Wrestles an Angel to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Marriage and Family and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Leisure and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Inspired Word of God and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Ten Commandments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

9. B — Apply the teaching of Marriage and Family with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
